Grand Group Corporation is a chemical company located at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. Based in the dynamic coastal city of Ningbo, the company benefits from one of China’s most important commercial and logistics hubs, with convenient access to major ports, industrial zones, and international trade networks. This strategic location supports the company’s role in serving customers across both domestic and global markets.

As a chemical enterprise, Grand Group Corporation is positioned within an industry that plays a vital role in manufacturing, agriculture, construction, energy, textiles, plastics, coatings, and many other sectors. The company is associated with the sourcing, supply, distribution, and business development of chemical products, working to connect manufacturers and end users through reliable commercial services. Its presence in Ningbo, a city known for strong import and export activity, gives it an advantage in coordinating supply chains, managing trade operations, and responding to customer requirements efficiently.

Grand Group Corporation aims to provide value through product knowledge, market awareness, and customer-focused service. In the chemical industry, quality control, regulatory compliance, safe handling, and dependable delivery are essential, and companies operating in this field must maintain high standards to support long-term business relationships. By operating from Pacific Plaza in Ningbo, Grand Group Corporation is well placed to communicate with partners, manage commercial activities, and participate in the continued growth of China’s chemical trade sector.

With its professional location, industry focus, and access to Ningbo’s strong transportation and business infrastructure, Grand Group Corporation represents a chemical company capable of supporting a wide range of industrial and commercial needs.
